I shipped nothing this run, and the HUD is not at 4 on the critic. The audit on this build scored 37 (extracting countdown) at 2/5 and 50 (arcade live) at 2/5. Screen 21 had already scored 2 earlier. I didn't score the other screens.

Each critic run was on a single picture, so there was no before/after comparison.

The same findings come up every time. Each one either goes against one of your rulings or needs your word first, so I left them alone:
- **Ammo hero:** the critic wants one 56px ammo number. It is 34px source now, which you set in v23.94.
- **Currency row:** the critic wants one row, "Credits 900 · XP 0", with the stash and bag line dropped. The stash and bag line is yours (cw-stashbag).
- **"$" on the bag line and scoreboard:** this is the credits value in career text, so I didn't change it to SP without your word.
- **Contracts:** the critic wants a maximum of 3. You said all of them (v6.79).
- **HUD box margins:** the critic wants a 5% safe margin on every box. I didn't try it.
- **Feed explanations and panel fills:** the critic wants the explaining lines in the feed cut and flat panel fills. I didn't try either.

The backpack hint is already 16px grey text from an earlier change (cw-hudhero, line 40281). It looks larger in the screenshots because of the HUD zoom.

There are three small fixes I could ship next without needing a ruling: brighten the idle hotbar icons, set the slot numbers to 16px, and merge the two extraction alert lines. Check the alert logic first before the merge.

Notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/b-30-ui-hud.md`. I added one question for you to `tools/handoff/console/questions.md` covering the four decisions above.

TASK PARTIAL: the HUD stays at 2/5 until you decide on the 56px ammo hero, the one-row currency block, "$" versus SP on the bag line and scoreboard, and the contracts maximum of 3. After that the small hotbar fixes can ship and the screens can be re-scored.
